files.README.md:
# Torholm Rowing Club - safety boat crews

Day logs from the duty officer land in daylogs/ as plain rows:

    <name> / <seat> / <status> / <note>

For every session the club keeps a crew roster in rosters/, one file
per day named YYYY-MM-DD.txt. A row goes on the roster only when its
status is cleared; provisional rows are trainees and stay off it.
Roster lines are written in the day log's row order as:

    - <name> (<seat>)
